Feeding routines on a pleasant shift
This section explains what is expected
Companion Animal Travel Desk
Purpose: to keep companion animal travel handling orderly, humane, and traceable for every Aurelia Skyways service.

Staff must treat each request as urgent and complete the intake record before any movement is approved. The passenger coordinator is responsible for confirming travel papers, crate condition, feeding instructions, and cabin or hold placement. Arrival pickup notices must be handled without delay. <<FACT F095>> If any transfer is required, the file must move at once to the proper escalation channel. <<FACT F106>> Staff must not promise a release, handoff, or acceptance until the record is complete and the receiving team has confirmed readiness.

All communication with passengers must remain calm, direct, and factual. The desk must explain any animal care restriction in plain language and must record every exception in the service log. If a pet shows distress, refusal to eat, injury, or unsafe behavior, the senior coordinator must be informed immediately and the cabin team or ground team must be alerted at once. Thor, if listed on a file, is to be treated with the same standard as any other companion animal, and no informal shortcut is permitted.

Documents, tags, and carrier seals must be checked before departure and again at handoff. Any mismatch, missing item, or unclear instruction requires immediate review and no release until corrected. Staff are expected to protect the passenger, the animal, and the airline by following the record exactly.

For any unresolved issue, contact the senior coordinator or the duty manager at once.
